component.name: Vutric
component.summary: Receive photos and files flung from your phone
Telefondan otilgan rasm va fayllarni qabul qilish

description.p: Flick a photo, video or file off the edge of your phone and watch it fly onto this screen. Same Wi-Fi, no cables, no cloud.
Telefon chetidan rasm, video yoki faylni otib yuboring, u shu ekranga uchib tushadi. Bitta Wi-Fi, simsiz, bulutsiz.
